title: M32 — Shared preparation tickets, offline taps, explicit undo and private realtime

pages.note: Actual domain orders, staff PIN session, PostgreSQL roles, private WebSocket relay, scoped HTTP reads and preparation receipts. Synthetic identities only. The supplied 65:1843 and 107:1222 frames guide the ticket grid, large phone controls and status words. Translations, batches and pack checkboxes are not fabricated. The device bezel, current clock and literal fixture data differ; pixel differences are informational. Alarm/push remain unfinished.

pages.note: Expanded original saved-tap review after an actual offline Got it gesture and native IndexedDB commit. Full original ticket, confirmation state, Copy, Check confirmation and explicit Close controls remain accessible at every width. This recovery panel extends the supplied 65:1843/107:1222 ticket layouts; those frames have no recovery panel, so pixel differences are informational. No acceptance or closure is inferred while offline.

pages.note: Actual Got it acceptance followed by an owner status undo through the domain command, SQL transaction and live ticket feed. The current ticket returns to New and asks for a fresh acknowledgement while the original accepted receipt and complete ticket remain available in Saved taps. Uses the supplied 65:1843/107:1222 layout references; their frames contain no historical review panel, so pixel differences are informational. All identities are synthetic.
